notes: Release-candidate confirmation (§8.4, pre-registered in docs/项目记录/发布候选预注册_100seed_20260930.md): 100 non-overlapping seeds 1001-1100, same GBSA target, split (300 init / 200 holdout / 600 pool), budget (5x50), XGB backend (5 members) and primary metric as the 30-seed development run.
